Markets.title: AU Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 53% to Rs 858 crore
Markets.summary: AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% increase in net profit to Rs 858 crore for the second quarter. This growth was driven by a lower gross non-performing assets ratio of 1.99% and a 25% reduction in provisions to Rs 359 crore.

Markets.title: Portfolio Killers: 10 US stocks that wiped out up to 66% of investors’ wealth in 2026
Markets.summary: In 2026, The Trade Desk's shares plummeted 65.75% from $37.96 to $13.00, making it the biggest loser on a list of wealth-destroying US stocks. Consequently, the digital advertising technology company's market capitalization has fallen to $6.1 billion.

Markets.title: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 10 stocks rally up to 100% in FY27 so far
Markets.summary: About 14 stocks in the Government of Singapore’s India portfolio have delivered positive returns so far in FY27, with 10 rallying up to 100%. Meanwhile, nearly half of the stocks in the portfolio have posted negative returns.

Markets.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 results: Consolidated PAT rises 26% YoY to Rs 5,645 crore;  NII up 16%
Markets.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 26% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax to Rs 5,645 crore for the second quarter. During the same period, its net interest income rose 16% to reach Rs 8,459 crore.

Markets.title: FIIs dump Indian stocks for 10th straight week as markets slide: Is the worst over or more pain ahead?
Markets.summary: Foreign Institutional Investors dumped Indian stocks for the tenth consecutive week as the Nifty 50 dropped 2.4 percent to close at 22,600. Selling pressure intensified across the market, causing the Bank Nifty to fall 2.8 percent and the Midcap and Smallcap indices to plunge 5.6 percent and 7.3 percent, respectively.

Markets.title: Bitcoin hovers near $80,000 and Ethereum at $2,370 as macro uncertainty and weak institutional flows weigh on crypto markets
Markets.summary: Bitcoin has dropped to about $80,685 and Ethereum has fallen to roughly $2,370 amid declining institutional interest and ETF outflows. Major altcoins like XRP and Dogecoin have also experienced decreases of up to 2.2% due to ongoing macroeconomic uncertainty.

Geo-Political.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
Geo-Political.summary: Nearly 1,000 people were arrested as hundreds of thousands participated in mass protests across France. Officials largely prevented a repeat of the widespread rioting and looting seen the previous weekend.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine reports that its Starlink satellite internet connection has stabilized following a week of network limits. The previous slowdowns had negatively impacted the country's military and drone operations.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli forces demolished Palestinian homes in Hebron following the killing of two Israeli soldiers by Palestinian gunmen. The demolitions occur just days before the Israeli election.

Geo-Political.title: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
Geo-Political.summary: A man was arrested after a fire broke out at Hitler's former Eagle's Nest mountain retreat in Germany. Approximately 200 emergency personnel responded to extinguish the blaze at the Alpine residence.

Geo-Political.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
Geo-Political.summary: Kaylub Giamanco killed a teenage gunman who had fatally shot three children and a teacher at an Oregon school. Giamanco expressed deep anguish over the children he was unable to save during the attack.

Geo-Political.title: British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas
Geo-Political.summary: A British woman died in the Bahamas after attempting to rescue her sons who were swept away at sea. Her husband stated that the loss of his childhood sweetheart is unimaginable for their family.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result for a relevant user query without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the growing shift from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO) for organic web traffic in 2025.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to simplify and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries to automate repetitive tasks and boost productivity. These widely adopted solutions are designed to improve overall workflow efficiency for multiple applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article reviews the top ten artificial intelligence content generator tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the most effective and efficient AI writer for their audience and needs.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also provides a list of top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: 500 GW by 2030: Experts explain why India needs to power up battery storage capacity and grid infra to meet the target
Data & Insights.summary: India must expand its battery storage and modernize its power grid to meet its target of 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030. As of July 31, 2026, the country has already installed 300.50 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity.

Data & Insights.title: India’s commerce and industry ministry working to identify AI proof sectors: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: India's commerce and industry ministry is working to identify economic sectors capable of withstanding artificial intelligence-led disruption. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced this initiative to prepare the country's industries for future technological changes.

Data & Insights.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
Data & Insights.summary: India is advancing construction on the 125-kilometer Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line, which will feature 16 tunnels. This infrastructure project is driving the expansion of the country's domestic tunnel boring machine manufacturing capabilities.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to faster manufacturing and services growth, rising new orders, and lower inflation. However, employment growth slowed to its weakest pace of the year during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
Data & Insights.summary: Taxing the top one percent alone is insufficient to resolve income inequality, as the effectiveness of government spending is equally crucial. Laws and social institutions must be reformed if they are unjust, since injustice is only acceptable when avoiding a greater one.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. Refiners increased spot purchases after Middle Eastern producers and traders boosted shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

India.title: Palace, Siblings And A 'Kansa Mama' Jibe: Jagan Reddy-Sister Row Over Wedding
India.summary: Anjili Reddy and Dr. Somala Raghuram Reddy are scheduled to marry on November 25, followed by a Hyderabad reception on December 5. The upcoming wedding has sparked a public dispute between Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy and his sister Y.S. Sharmila involving a palace venue and political jibes.

India.title: India Issues Fresh Advisory For Umrah Pilgrims In Saudi Arabia
India.summary: India has issued a new advisory for Umrah pilgrims traveling to Saudi Arabia. The Indian mission is coordinating with Saudi authorities to resolve flight disruptions, visa validity issues, and delayed departures.

India.title: Same Name Appears 10 Times On Voter Roll. 5 UP Poll Officials Get Notices
India.summary: Five Uttar Pradesh poll officials received notices after the Samajwadi Party alleged that a single person's name appeared 10 times on the Azamgarh constituency voter roll. Election authorities are currently investigating the discrepancy in the electoral list.

India.title: Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh Gets One-Year Extension
India.summary: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet has approved a one-year extension for Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh. His tenure will now continue beyond the originally scheduled end date of October 31, 2026.

India.title: Probe Agency ED Moves Top Court Against Quashing Of NewsClick Case
India.summary: India's Enforcement Directorate has appealed to the Supreme Court against the high court's decision to quash its money laundering case against NewsClick. The agency argued that the high court failed to examine the merits of the case and delayed releasing its judgment by five months.

India.title: Delhi Man Arrested Over 'Sting Op' Video Targeting Siddaramaiah
India.summary: A Delhi man has been arrested in connection with an alleged sting operation targeting Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah. Siddaramaiah previously dismissed the video as a fabricated blackmail attempt and called for a thorough investigation.

General.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
General.summary: Nearly 1,000 people were arrested following mass protests and clashes across France. Officials largely prevented a repeat of the widespread rioting and looting that occurred the previous weekend.

General.title: Watch: BBC in Paris as police charge protesters and use tear gas during unrest
General.summary: BBC Europe correspondent Nick Beake reports from Paris about unrest that erupted after nightfall following mostly peaceful protests. Police charged protesters and used tear gas to manage the situation.

General.title: Storm Boelo amber warnings kick in as parts of UK brace for 80mph gusts
General.summary: Amber weather warnings for high winds have been issued for Scotland, parts of northern England, and Northern Ireland as Storm Boelo arrives. The region is bracing for gusts of up to 80mph during the country's second consecutive day of severe storms.

General.title: Ukraine depends on Starlink - can Europe plug the gap?
General.summary: Ukraine currently relies heavily on Elon Musk's Starlink network for satellite internet access. Europe does not yet have a comparable alternative service to replace it.

General.title: Met Police says letter with claims about Meghan's father not shared with other law enforcement
General.summary: The Metropolitan Police stated they passed information regarding Meghan Markle's father to the duchess. They confirmed this information was not shared with any other law enforcement agencies.

General.title: Voters in Brazil to choose between Lula and Bolsonaro's son
General.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of Brazil's jailed former president, is challenging Lula in the upcoming election. Lula, who is 80 years old, is running for his fourth term in office.
